narrative_purpose: Reveal the biological interface behind riding: the Na'vi and mount queues are sheathed nerve bundles that open into many fine tendrils and physically interlace, turning rider and animal into one bidirectional control-and-sensation circuit.
subject: An intimate anatomical close-up of a Na'vi neural queue and a direhorse neural queue meeting between rider and mount. Both flexible skin sheaths open at their tips into fans of dozens of fine living tendrils, pink-cyan and moist, which interlace densely like two hands clasping. The bases of the tendrils continue visibly into bundled nerve fibres beneath each sheath; the rider's blue hand and the direhorse's neck remain softly out of focus behind the connection.
scene: Held close against the shadowed side of a direhorse at dusk, with background grass and the bodies reduced to soft indigo-teal forms.
camera: Extreme macro three-quarter view centred on the point of interlacing, shallow depth of field that still preserves the two distinct sheath origins.
light: The neural tendrils emit a restrained cyan and magenta living glow that lights the sheath edges from within; soft cool ambient dusk and deep shadow surround the join.
palette: Void indigo background, ocean teal skin and sheath, Pandora cyan and restrained biolum magenta in the neural fibres, no warm artificial light.
style: Painterly speculative-biology anatomical plate, hand-painted, intimate and organic, precise without clinical sterility.
detail_level: Very crisp on individual tendrils, moist living texture, and continuity into nerve bundles; hand, neck, and landscape softly blurred.
composition: The two queues enter from opposite sides and meet just off centre, with generous dark negative space around the interlace and no other focal object.
consistency_notes: The connection is physical living nervous tissue, not telepathy or technology. Both tips open into many fine tendrils; the light is restrained biological signal, not neon electricity.
negative_prompt: no text, no labels, no arrows, no metal or plastic connector, no cable plug, no floating magic, no gore, no neon cyberpunk glow, no photographic surgery, no glossy 3D render, no cartoon or anime style
